title: Waiter / Waitress
description:
Summary
Serve guests, take orders, deliver food and drinks, and keep the floor running well.
Duties and Responsibilities
Greet/seat; explain menu; note allergies; upsell specials.
Take orders accurately; send to kitchen/bar; serve on time.
Check-backs; handle bills and payments; clear/reset tables.
Solve guest issues quickly; escalate to Manager when needed.
Keep service areas tidy; follow hygiene and safety steps.
Job Requirements
1+ year FOH service preferred.
POS basics; clear English/Tok Pisin; neat grooming.
Customer-first mindset; can work nights/weekends.
Grooming & Hygiene (FOH):
clean uniform (spare shirt), daily shower & deodorant, fresh breath, no strong scents, hair neat/tied, short clean nails, minimal jewellery, closed non-slip shoes; no gum; no smoke/vape odour. Manager may stand you down to correct.
Others
Hours & breaks per PNG law
Alcohol service rules apply where relevant; follow ID/age checks.
Reports to: Restaurant Manager / Floor Supervisor.
